outcome: maternal awareness during general anaesthesia induction
neonatal Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: Ninety patients scheduled for elective caesarean section under general anaesthesia were included.
finding: Remifentanil and dexmedetomidine, when added to propofol, similarly affected maternal awareness and neonatal Apgar scores compared with propofol alone, but remifentanil was superior in controlling haemodynamic responses to sympathetic stimuli.
